models.name: civic_board_configurations
models.description: System-wide configuration entries stored as independent key-value records. Used to toggle features, define thresholds, or set URIs across the platform. This table is intentionally decoupled from domain content and identities to avoid dependency cycles. Managed primarily by administrators through configuration UIs or scripts; referenced by runtime services to read current settings. No foreign keys are declared to other domains.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration identifier (e.g., "public_read", "attachments.max_count"). Serves as the business key for lookups.

plainFields.name: value_string
plainFields.description: String value for this configuration when applicable. Only one of the typed value columns is expected to be used per row.

plainFields.name: value_int
plainFields.description: Integer value for this configuration when applicable (e.g., numeric limits).

plainFields.name: value_double
plainFields.description: Decimal value for this configuration when applicable (e.g., thresholds or ratios).

plainFields.name: value_boolean
plainFields.description: Boolean value for this configuration when applicable (e.g., feature toggle).

plainFields.name: value_uri
plainFields.description: URI value for this configuration when applicable (e.g., callback URLs, CDN endpoints).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable explanation of the configuration purpose and usage.

plainFields.name: effective_since
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp indicating when this configuration became effective.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for retention and operational safety.

models.name: civic_board_policies
models.description: System policies governing platform behavior such as public-read, moderation defaults, and feature switches. Each policy is an independently managed record with an optional effective window. This table is maintained by administrators and does not reference domain content directly. Related changes are recorded in {@link civic_board_audit_logs}.

plainFields.name: policy_code
plainFields.description: Stable policy identifier (e.g., "public_read", "attachments.policy", "report.duplicate_cooldown_hours"). Unique across the system.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-friendly policy name for administrative UIs.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Optional category for grouping related policies (e.g., "visibility", "attachments", "reporting").

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Whether the policy is currently enabled. For value-carrying policies, this indicates if enforcement is active.

plainFields.name: value_string
plainFields.description: Optional string value carried by the policy (e.g., textual rule).

plainFields.name: value_int
plainFields.description: Optional integer value (e.g., max counts, cooldown hours).

plainFields.name: value_double
plainFields.description: Optional decimal value (e.g., size limits in MB with fractional precision).

plainFields.name: starts_at
plainFields.description: Optional start of the policy’s effective window (UTC).

plainFields.name: ends_at
plainFields.description: Optional end of the policy’s effective window (UTC).

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Administrative notes describing policy rationale or change context (not shown to end users).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for retention and operational safety.

models.name: civic_board_audit_logs
models.description: Append-only audit trail capturing security- and compliance-relevant events across the system. Records the acting entity (user/admin/system), optional session context, target reference, action name, outcome, and request metadata. Designed for historical analysis and investigations; not intended for direct user manipulation. This table provides the system’s audit history for changes in {@link civic_board_policies} and {@link civic_board_configurations}, as well as domain operations.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor that initiated the event (e.g., "user", "admin", "system"). Stored as raw text to avoid cross-domain foreign keys.

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the actor, when applicable. Stored without a foreign key to avoid domain coupling.

plainFields.name: actor_session_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the actor session when applicable. Stored without a foreign key to avoid domain coupling.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Business action name (e.g., "post.create", "comment.delete", "policy.update").

plainFields.name: outcome
plainFields.description: Outcome summary (e.g., "success", "failure:rate_limited").

plainFields.name: target_table
plainFields.description: Target table name when the action is scoped to a resource (e.g., "civic_board_posts").

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: Target resource identifier when applicable. Stored without foreign key to avoid coupling.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed for the request context, when available.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full request URL, when available.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL, when available.

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable message or error context to aid investigations.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Event creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for any administrative update (e.g., redaction). Normally equal to created_at for immutable entries.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for retention or legal hold workflows.

models.name: civic_board_rate_limits
models.description: Operational store for rate limiting windows and counters per actor and scope. Managed by the system to enforce anti-abuse policies (e.g., post/comment/report creation, login attempts). Records are created/updated within short time windows and expired/cleaned by background tasks. No foreign keys to identities to avoid cross-domain coupling.

plainFields.name: scope
plainFields.description: Logical action scope for the rate limit (e.g., "post.create", "comment.create", "report.create", "login.failed").

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Actor type constrained by business logic (e.g., "user", "admin", "ip"). Stored as text to avoid cross-domain keys.

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the actor when applicable (e.g., user/admin). For IP-scoped limits, this may be a surrogate or left null if not applicable.

plainFields.name: window_started_at
plainFields.description: Start timestamp (UTC) of the rate limit window represented by this record.

plainFields.name: window_ends_at
plainFields.description: End timestamp (UTC) of the rate limit window represented by this record.

plainFields.name: count
plainFields.description: Number of actions performed during the window at the time of update.

plainFields.name: limit
plainFields.description: Enforced maximum actions allowed during the window per actor and scope.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp to permit safe retention before purge.

models.name: civic_board_users
models.description: Registered member accounts for the civicBoard application. Stores authentication credentials and profile-facing display attributes. Serves as the primary identity for regular users who author posts and comments. Related entities include session records {@link civic_board_user_sessions} and verification/reset flows via {@link civic_board_email_verification_of_users} and {@link civic_board_password_reset_token_of_users}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Login and contact email for the user. Must be unique across all users and used for verification workflows.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt or similar password hash for authentication. Never store plain passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Public display name shown on authored content instead of email for privacy.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the user’s email has been verified. Governs posting/commenting eligibility.

plainFields.name: suspended
plainFields.description: Whether the account is currently suspended and restricted from creating or modifying content.

plainFields.name: suspended_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was suspended, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion time (UTC). Null when active.

models.name: civic_board_user_sessions
models.description: Authenticated session records for {@link civic_board_users}. Follows the exact session table pattern: one actor FK, connection context (ip, href, referrer), created_at, and optional expired_at. Managed through authentication flows for audit and authorization context.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed when establishing the session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL that initiated the session (connection URL).

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL captured at session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time (UTC).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration/end time (UTC), when present.

models.name: civic_board_admins
models.description: Administrator accounts with elevated privileges for moderation and policy management. Admins can review reports, hide or delete content, and manage board-level policies. Related entities include {@link civic_board_admin_sessions} and verification/reset flows via {@link civic_board_email_verification_of_admins} and {@link civic_board_password_reset_token_of_admins}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Login and contact email for the admin. Must be unique across all admins and used in verification flows.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt or similar password hash for administrator authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Administrator display name surfaced in audit trails and moderation actions.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the admin’s email is verified.

plainFields.name: suspended
plainFields.description: Whether the admin account has been suspended from taking privileged actions.

plainFields.name: suspended_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was suspended, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion time (UTC). Null when active.

models.name: civic_board_admin_sessions
models.description: Authenticated session records for {@link civic_board_admins}. Strictly follows the session table pattern with a single admin FK, connection context, created_at and optional expired_at. Used for auditing privileged actions and enforcing role-aware permissions.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address when the administrator session was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL that initiated the admin session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL captured at session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time (UTC).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration/end time (UTC), when applicable.

models.name: civic_board_email_verifications
models.description: Main email verification tokens used to confirm ownership of an email address for either users or admins. Implements the polymorphic ownership pattern: a main entity with actor_type discriminator ("user" | "admin") and subtype tables {@link civic_board_email_verification_of_users}, {@link civic_board_email_verification_of_admins} that each enforce a 1:1 link to this token and hold the actor-specific FKs.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Actor discriminator for polymorphic ownership. Allowed values: "user" or "admin".

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address to be verified. Captured at token issuance for audit and delivery traceability.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque verification token string used to confirm email ownership. Must be unique across all active tokens.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration time (UTC). Tokens are invalid after this timestamp.

plainFields.name: used
plainFields.description: Whether this verification token has already been consumed.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was consumed, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion time (UTC). Null when active.

models.name: civic_board_email_verification_of_users
models.description: Subtype table connecting a main email verification token to a specific user. Enforces a strict 1:1 relationship with {@link civic_board_email_verifications} and holds the required user FK for referential integrity without nullable proliferation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation time of the subtype link (UTC).

models.name: civic_board_email_verification_of_admins
models.description: Subtype table connecting a main email verification token to a specific administrator. Enforces 1:1 uniqueness to {@link civic_board_email_verifications} and maintains a required FK to {@link civic_board_admins} to guarantee integrity for admin email verification flows.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation time of the subtype link (UTC).

models.name: civic_board_password_reset_tokens
models.description: Main password reset tokens for account recovery. Polymorphically owned by either users or admins via actor_type field and subtype tables {@link civic_board_password_reset_token_of_users}, {@link civic_board_password_reset_token_of_admins}. The main entity carries token lifecycle attributes; subtypes enforce actor-specific FKs with a 1:1 uniqueness to the main token.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Actor discriminator for polymorphic ownership. Allowed values: "user" or "admin".

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque password reset token string. Must be unique across all active tokens.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration time (UTC) after which the token is invalid.

plainFields.name: used
plainFields.description: Whether this reset token has already been consumed.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was consumed, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion time (UTC). Null when active.

models.name: civic_board_password_reset_token_of_users
models.description: Subtype table connecting a main password reset token to a specific user. Enforces a strict 1:1 relationship with {@link civic_board_password_reset_tokens} and holds the required user FK to maintain normalization and data integrity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation time of the subtype link (UTC).

models.name: civic_board_password_reset_token_of_admins
models.description: Subtype table connecting a main password reset token to a specific administrator. Enforces 1:1 uniqueness to {@link civic_board_password_reset_tokens} and maintains a required FK to {@link civic_board_admins} to guarantee integrity for admin password reset flows.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation time of the subtype link (UTC).

models.name: civic_board_posts
models.description: Discussion board posts (articles) authored by users. Contains the title, body, and lifecycle status with publication and edit timestamps. Each post is created by a {@link civic_board_users} actor. Optionally links to the authoring {@link civic_board_user_sessions} for audit context without risking content deletion when sessions expire (nullable + onDelete:SetNull). Comments ({@link civic_board_comments}) and attachments ({@link civic_board_post_attachments}) reference this entity. Visibility and moderation operate via status (Published/Hidden/Deleted) and administrative records in {@link civic_board_moderation_actions}.

foreignFields.name: civic_board_user_session_id
foreignFields.description: Authoring session's {@link civic_board_user_sessions.id}. Nullable and set null on session deletion to preserve content.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Post title. Business limits: 1–120 characters, trimmed, non-whitespace.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Post body text. Business limits: 1–20,000 characters, plain text with line breaks allowed.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of the post. Expected values: "Published", "Hidden", or "Deleted". Used to control visibility and commenting eligibility.

plainFields.name: published_at
plainFields.description: Publication timestamp recorded when the post becomes publicly visible (Published).

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: Last content edit timestamp within the allowed edit window; null if never edited.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (auditable).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this record (auditable).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active; set when Deleted to support retention/purge policies.

models.name: civic_board_post_attachments
models.description: File attachments associated with posts. Attachments inherit visibility rules from their parent {@link civic_board_posts}. Each row stores immutable file metadata and storage URI. Only posts (not comments) can have attachments. Uploaded by a user through a session for auditability. Session link is nullable and set null on deletion to avoid unintended content loss.

foreignFields.name: civic_board_user_session_id
foreignFields.description: Uploader session's {@link civic_board_user_sessions.id}. Nullable and set null on session deletion to preserve the attachment record.

plainFields.name: uri
plainFields.description: Storage URI pointing to the attached file object.

plainFields.name: original_filename
plainFields.description: User-facing original filename after sanitization; used for display and duplicate prevention per post.

plainFields.name: content_type
plainFields.description: MIME type detected/accepted (e.g., image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, application/pdf).

plainFields.name: byte_size
plainFields.description: File size in bytes; used to enforce per-file and per-post total limits in application logic.

plainFields.name: image_width
plainFields.description: Image width in pixels if the attachment is an image; null for non-image types.

plainFields.name: image_height
plainFields.description: Image height in pixels if the attachment is an image; null for non-image types.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Attachment creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Attachment last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for retention/purge handling.

models.name: civic_board_comments
models.description: Plain-text comments on posts. Each comment belongs to a {@link civic_board_posts} and is authored by a {@link civic_board_users}. Optionally links the {@link civic_board_user_sessions} for audit context without risking content deletion (nullable + onDelete:SetNull). Lifecycle status governs visibility and moderation (Published/Hidden/Deleted). Comments are listed oldest-first under a post and support cross-post queries by author.

foreignFields.name: civic_board_user_session_id
foreignFields.description: Authoring session's {@link civic_board_user_sessions.id}. Nullable and set null on session deletion to preserve the comment.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment body text. Business limits: 1–2,000 characters (minimal scope); text-only (no attachments).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of the comment. Expected values: "Published", "Hidden", or "Deleted".

plainFields.name: published_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment became publicly visible (Published).

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: Last edit timestamp within the 15-minute window; null if never edited.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (auditable).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this record (auditable).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for retention/purge policies.

models.name: civic_board_reports
models.description: User-submitted moderation requests (reports) across posts or comments. Holds common report metadata such as reason, optional note, and workflow status. Exactly one specialization row must exist in either {@link civic_board_report_of_posts} or {@link civic_board_report_of_comments} to bind the report to its concrete target. Admins review these records and create {@link civic_board_moderation_actions} as resolutions. Reporters may query their own reports via the specialization tables using the reporter identity.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reporter-selected categorical reason (e.g., Spam, Harassment, Off-topic, Other). Business validation occurs at application level.

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Optional free-text note from the reporter, up to 500 characters per business rules.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Workflow state of this report such as "pending" or "resolved" for queue management.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (UTC) when the report was filed.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC) for this report metadata.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp (UTC) when the report is removed from public/admin queues but retained for policy retention.

models.name: civic_board_report_of_posts
models.description: Specialization of {@link civic_board_reports} that binds a report to a specific post and captures the reporter identity and session for audit and constraint enforcement. One-to-one with {@link civic_board_reports}. Prevents duplicate reports by the same user on the same post via a composite unique constraint.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (UTC) when this specialization was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC) for this specialization.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp (UTC) if this specialization is logically removed.

models.name: civic_board_report_of_comments
models.description: Specialization of {@link civic_board_reports} that binds a report to a specific comment and captures the reporter identity and session for audit and constraint enforcement. One-to-one with {@link civic_board_reports}. Prevents duplicate reports by the same user on the same comment via a composite unique constraint.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (UTC) when this specialization was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC) for this specialization.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp (UTC) if this specialization is logically removed.

models.name: civic_board_moderation_actions
models.description: Administrative resolution records for {@link civic_board_reports}. Captures the acting admin and session with the chosen decision (Hide, Delete, or No Action) and an optional note. Enforces a single resolution per report via a unique FK, creating an immutable audit trail separate from content state changes.

foreignFields.name: civic_board_report_id
foreignFields.description: Resolved report's {@link civic_board_reports.id}. One action per report.

plainFields.name: decision
plainFields.description: Resolution outcome string such as "No Action", "Hide", or "Delete".

plainFields.name: outcome_note
plainFields.description: Optional moderator note providing rationale for the decision.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (UTC) when the moderation action was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (UTC) for this moderation action record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp (UTC) if the action record is withdrawn administratively.

models.name: civic_board_post_reactions
models.description: User single-like reactions on posts. Each row represents at most one reaction per (user, post) pair. The reaction is considered active when not soft-deleted (deleted_at is NULL). Designed to support toggle semantics by updating timestamps while preserving auditability. References {@link civic_board_users} as the reacting actor and {@link civic_board_posts} as the target content. Hidden or Deleted targets must block new reactions at the application layer; self-like is prevented by business rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp when the reaction was first added (Like on).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp, including toggling operations.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp representing Like off toggle. NULL means the reaction is currently active.

models.name: civic_board_comment_reactions
models.description: User single-like reactions on comments. Each row represents at most one reaction per (user, comment) pair. The reaction is active when deleted_at is NULL, enabling toggle behavior without losing history. References {@link civic_board_users} as the reacting actor and {@link civic_board_comments} as the target comment. Hidden or Deleted targets must block new reactions at the application layer; self-like is prevented by business rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp when the reaction was first added (Like on).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp, including toggling operations.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp representing Like off toggle. NULL means the reaction is currently active.

models.name: civic_board_reaction_policies
models.description: Administrative policy controlling whether reactions are enabled and under what constraints. This table allows feature toggling and guardrails such as self-like prohibition and per-user rate limits. It is managed independently by admins and referenced by application logic at runtime. Does not denormalize any computed counters. Related entities: users {@link civic_board_users} for ownership context if needed; targets are {@link civic_board_posts} and {@link civic_board_comments}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Human-readable policy code identifier (e.g., "default"). Used to select the active configuration.

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Whether reactions feature is globally enabled.

plainFields.name: allow_on_posts
plainFields.description: Whether reactions are permitted on posts.

plainFields.name: allow_on_comments
plainFields.description: Whether reactions are permitted on comments.

plainFields.name: allow_self_like
plainFields.description: Whether self-like is permitted. Should remain false to satisfy product rules.

plainFields.name: max_reactions_per_user_per_day
plainFields.description: Optional cap on the number of reactions a single user may add per calendar day. NULL means unlimited per this policy.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of this policy row.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of this policy row.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for deprecated or replaced policies. NULL means active.
